summary: Iter91 — Taxi-Bestellfluss Konkurrenz-Parity Sprint (Frontend-only) VERIFIED end-to-end via Playwright on /taxi (anonymous session). All 7 requested acceptance criteria pass: (1) Mapbox map mounts DIRECTLY on landing (no taxi-type pre-screen) — canvas=1 inside data-testid='taxi-map-container'; (2) Top-bar 'map-flow-current-address' is rendered (showed 'Standortzugriff verweigert' fallback because preview Playwright session denies geolocation — UI surface is correct); (3) Bottom-sheet 'TaxiBookingSheet' is mounted collapsed with all expected testids: taxi-pickup-row, taxi-dropoff-row, taxi-add-waypoint, taxi-options-btn, taxi-show-prices-btn, taxi-change-type-btn; (4) After programmatically setting dropoff via the public window.__taxiSetDropoffPOI bridge (Berlin Friedrichshain), the Mapbox Directions API was auto-called (route polyline drawn — layer 'taxi-route-line') AND /api/taxi/* estimate endpoint was auto-fired (no manual button click required — the new useEffect debounced auto-estimate works); (5) taxi-book-btn became visible AFTER pickup+dropoff valid (was absent before); (6) Driver-marker CSS class .taxi-driver-marker correctly absent without active ride (logic verified by code review of useTaxiMap.js lines 247-271 — marker only mounts when driverLocation prop is set, with transition: transform 1.2s linear for smooth movement); (7) Backend not retested per request (frontend-only).

issues: When geolocation is denied (preview Playwright + many real users who reject the prompt), the 'STANDORT' chip shows 'Standortzugriff verweigert. Bitte Berecht…' truncated — consider a cleaner empty-state (icon + 'GPS aktivieren' CTA) instead of a long truncated German error in a pill.

action_items: (Optional UX polish) Improve the 'GPS-denied' state in the top-bar — currently shows a truncated German error message inside the address chip; replace with a tappable 'GPS aktivieren' CTA that re-requests permission.
critical_code_review_comments: useTaxiMap.js drawRoute: correctly handles both first-add (addSource+addLayer) and subsequent updates (setData) via routeSourceAddedRef — no leak risk on style switch (BUT: setStyle wipes all sources/layers; routeSourceAddedRef stays true, so after style switch the next dropoff change will try setData on a non-existent source — minor edge case, recommend resetting routeSourceAddedRef = false inside the mapStyle useEffect).

useTaxiMap.js driver-marker effect (lines 247-271): smooth movement relies on the marker element's own CSS transition:transform 1.2s linear — Mapbox internally rewrites the element's transform on setLngLat, so the transition is honored. ✅ implemented per requirement.
useTaxiState.js: taxiType default 'business' is correct for the parity sprint — the inMapBookingFlow gate (TaxiPage.jsx line 464) now evaluates true on first render and the map mounts immediately.
frontend/.env: REACT_APP_MAPBOX_TOKEN appears exactly once (verified). No duplicates.
TaxiPage.jsx auto-estimate useEffect (lines 381-388): debounced 400ms, properly guards on moduleEnabled+taxiType+pickup.lat+dropoff.lat, eslint-disable comment is justified (intentional). ✅
TaxiPage.jsx driverLocation prop wiring (lines 138-140): correctly passes {lat,lng} only when both driver_lat AND driver_lng truthy, else null. Marker un-mounts cleanly when ride completes.
test_credentials: Anonymous session used — login not required for /taxi landing flow. Verified bridge: window.__taxiSetDropoffPOI(lng,lat,name) is a stable hook for end-to-end automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright will report the data-testid='taxi-map-container' as 'hidden' even though it is functionally rendered — this is because of the absolutely-positioned bottom-sheet overlapping the container in stacking checks. Don't fail on wait_for_selector(state='visible') for this element — instead assert (a) element exists, (b) canvas count inside >= 1, (c) bounding-rect height > 400. The auto-estimate flow can be reliably triggered without UI by calling window.__taxiSetDropoffPOI(lng, lat, name) — this is the same global bridge the POI-popup buttons use, so testing through it exercises the same setDropoff() path. Backend /api/taxi/estimate, /book, /status were NOT retested this iteration per the explicit 'frontend only(skip backend)' instruction; previous iterations confirm them green.
rca of the issue: N/A — sprint A complete, all 5 pre-sprint problems are resolved: (1) map mounts directly via taxiType-default='business' + inMapBookingFlow gate; (2) .env de-duplicated to single REACT_APP_MAPBOX_TOKEN; (3) auto-estimate useEffect (debounced 400ms) replaces the manual button-click flow; (4) drawRoute() + Mapbox Directions API draws cyan polyline (layer 'taxi-route-line') with black shadow underlayer; (5) driver-marker effect with CSS transition:transform 1.2s linear is in place — yellow 🚕 marker with class 'taxi-driver-marker' will mount as soon as activeRide.driver_lat/lng is polled.
